verdict: instrument leak (b): all 12 correct checkpoints occur at distance 2, which is inside the 4-turn unmasked window, so the fact's tool output body (and for turns 3-4 also the prior model answer) is still in the prompt. masked_rows=0 at every one of those turns, so they fail the arm's own activation predicate (masked_rows>0) and are not masked-fact successes. The scorer counts them because answer_of matches the expected value, but they are unmasked-window reads, not recall of a masked fact. This explains the 0/12 on TX-01 (single checkpoint at turn 20, outside the window) vs 12/48 on TX-02 (d=2 bucket inside the window).
